name: UnSub (Aurora/Aur0ra ransomware affiliate, Cursor AI abuse) — Gambit Security
akas: Aurora / Aur0ra RaaS affiliate (Russian-speaking); also independently tracked by CloudSEK
brief: Gambit Security found 28 exposed Cursor agentic-coding-assistant chat sessions (Cursor running Claude Sonnet 4.5) on a misconfigured command server, covering 10 targets between April 8 and May 21, 2026. Operators supplied credentials or an existing route into the victim network, then tasked the agent — under a "this is an authorized penetration test" pretext — with reconnaissance/subnet scanning, VPN-client installation, domain-privilege enumeration, certificate attacks, and coercing authentication for NTLM-relay attacks; Gambit assesses the AI assistance likely sped up the break-ins by "30, 40, 50%." Reuters independently confirmed 6 named victims (Christeyns–Belgium, Teckentrup–Germany, Helideck Certification Agency–Scotland, an Argentine pharma distributor, an Italian manufacturer, Bayou Title–Louisiana); a separate exposed open directory showed the broader Aurora affiliate campaign hit 20+ organizations across 9 countries between April and July 2026. Gambit Security
activity: Apr 8 – May 21, 2026 (broader affiliate campaign Apr–Jul 2026 per CloudSEK)
